# Project Setup and Architecture Design

## Objective

Design and implement the foundational architecture for the new microservices platform, including infrastructure setup, service templates, and deployment pipelines.

## Key Deliverables

- [ ] Architecture documentation
- [ ] Service template creation
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline setup
- [ ] Infrastructure as code configuration
- [x] Initial project structure
- [x] Team onboarding materials

## Timeline

**Start Date**: January 10, 2024
**Target Completion**: January 25, 2024
**Status**: In Progress (60% complete)

## Team Members

- **Lead**: [[jane_smith]] (Technical Lead)
- **DevOps**: [[mike_johnson]] (Infrastructure)
- **Backend**: [[sarah_wilson]] (Services)

## Technical Requirements

### Infrastructure
- Kubernetes cluster setup
- Service mesh configuration (Istio)
- Monitoring and observability stack

### Development
- Go microservice templates
- API gateway configuration
- Database schema management

## Progress Notes

### Week 1 (Jan 10-12)
- ✅ Initial architecture discussions
- ✅ Technology stack decisions
- ✅ Repository structure created

### Week 2 (Jan 15-19)
- 🔄 Service template development
- 🔄 CI/CD pipeline implementation
- ⏳ Infrastructure provisioning

## Related Tasks

- [[kubernetes_cluster_setup]] (Infrastructure)
- [[api_gateway_configuration]] (Backend Services)
- [[monitoring_stack_deployment]] (DevOps)

## Dependencies

- Security team approval for infrastructure design
- Budget approval for cloud resources
- Completion of [[team_onboarding_materials]]

## Risk Mitigation

- **Timeline Risk**: Parallel development tracks to avoid bottlenecks
- **Technical Risk**: Proof of concept implementations for critical components
- **Resource Risk**: Cross-training team members on key technologies
